text: In winter a grand hotel on the Ostend seafront stands empty except for the newlyweds Stefan and Valerie, until the Hungarian countess Elizabeth Báthory arrives with her companion Ilona, a guest the concierge remembers [looking no older decades ago|origin|evil outliving death]. Stefan is drawn to her tales of girls' blood, and [beats Valerie in their room|wrong|cruelty at home]. As the countess draws the young wife under her spell, a death in the bathroom leaves the women [drinking from Stefan's slashed wrists|threat|blood drinkers].
